multimodal_capability_policy: Explicitly requested Gemma/Qwen general instruct candidates are tested only as text; optional vision/audio-specific variants are excluded.
model_identity_limit: Installed filenames and native metadata are measured identifiers; upstream immutable model revision is not asserted.

exclusions.magistratura/qwen3.5-4b: Byte-identical duplicate of unsloth/qwen3.5-4b Q8_0; both full-file SHA256 values recorded in inventory.json. One underlying model, not two architectures.
exclusions.qwen-image-2.1-uncensored: Image generation; not a text question-answering candidate.
exclusions.qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct: Audio/vision-oriented multimodal variant; irrelevant modality adds a distinct runtime burden outside the normal text screen.
exclusions.webworld-8b-i1: Specialized agent/web-world fine-tune; deferred outside the ten requested normal general instruct candidates.
exclusions.dr-venus-4b-rl: Specialized reasoning RL fine-tune; deferred outside the ten normal general instruct candidates, not classified as uncensored.
exclusions.qwen3-coder-next: Coder-specific model; task does not require code generation.
exclusions.qwen3.6-35b-a3b-uncensored-hauhaucs-aggr: Aggressive/uncensored variant; a normal Qwen35B instruct candidate is installed.
exclusions.qwen3-vl-8b-instruct: Vision-specific variant; vision capability irrelevant to this text benchmark.
exclusions.qwen3-8b-deepseek-v3.2-speciale-distill: Specialized distilled reasoning fine-tune; normal Qwen instruct candidates available and predefined ten-candidate scope sufficient.

first_completed_model_context_observatio.scope: This observation covers only Gemma12 DEV60; all-model full293 fit is checked by actual successful calls, not inferred from this one model.
